metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Email Event ASIM filtering parser for Proofpoint POD message logs
properties.query:
let single_string = (value:dynamic) {
  case(gettype(value) == "array", iff(array_length(value) == 1 and gettype(value[0]) == "string", tostring(value[0]), ""),
       gettype(value) == "string", tostring(value), "")
};
let address_array = (value:dynamic) {
  // Validate string arrays without expanding message records.
  case(gettype(value) == "array" and tostring(value) matches regex @'^\[\s*(?:"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"\s*(?:,\s*"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"\s*)*)?\]$', value,
       gettype(value) == "string" and isnotempty(tostring(value)), pack_array(tostring(value)),
       dynamic([]))
};
let mailbox = (value:dynamic) {
  let text = single_string(value);
  trim(" ", iff(text contains "<", tostring(split(tostring(split(text, "<")[-1]), ">")[0]), text))
};
let parser = (
    starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
    endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailfromaddress_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailrecipient_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailsubject_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emaildirection_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emaildeliverylocation_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    eventresult:string='*',
    pack:bool=false) {
  let spf_results = dynamic({"pass":"Pass","fail":"Fail","softfail":"SoftFail","neutral":"Neutral","none":"None","temperror":"TemporaryError","permerror":"PermanentError"});
  let dkim_results = dynamic({"pass":"Pass","fail":"Fail","none":"None","temperror":"TemporaryError","permerror":"PermanentError"});
  let dmarc_results = dynamic({"pass":"Pass","fail":"Fail","none":"None","bestguesspass":"BestGuessPass"});
  // Escape each prefix before joining alternatives so dots and other metacharacters stay literal.
  let prefix_pattern = strcat("(?i)^(?:", replace_string(replace_regex(strcat_array(ipaddr_has_any_prefix, "\u001f"), @"([\\.^$|?*+()\[\]{}])", @"\\\1"), "\u001f", "|"), ")");
  ProofpointPODMessage_CL
  | where isnull(starttime) or eventTime >= starttime
  | where isnull(endtime) or eventTime <= endtime
  | where eventresult in ("*", "NA")
  | extend
      EmailFromAddress = single_string(msg.parsedAddresses.from),
      EmailToRecipients = address_array(msg.parsedAddresses.['to']),
      EmailCCRecipients = address_array(msg.parsedAddresses.cc),
      EmailBCCRecipients = address_array(msg.parsedAddresses.bcc),
      EmailSubject = coalesce(single_string(msg.normalizedHeader.subject), single_string(msg.header.subject)),
      _source_ip = tostring(connection.ip),
      _direction = tolower(tostring(['filter'].routeDirection))
  | extend
      SrcIpAddr = iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(_source_ip)) or isnotempty(parse_ipv6(_source_ip)), _source_ip, ""),
      EmailDirection = case(_direction == "inbound", "Inbound", _direction == "outbound", "Outbound", _direction == "internal", "Internal", _direction == "local", "Local", "Unknown")
  | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or (isnotempty(SrcIpAddr) and SrcIpAddr matches regex prefix_pattern)
  | where array_length(emailfromaddress_has_any) == 0 or EmailFromAddress has_any (emailfromaddress_has_any)
  | where array_length(emailrecipient_has_any) == 0 or tostring(EmailToRecipients) has_any (emailrecipient_has_any) or tostring(EmailCCRecipients) has_any (emailrecipient_has_any) or tostring(EmailBCCRecipients) has_any (emailrecipient_has_any)
  | where array_length(emailsubject_has_any) == 0 or EmailSubject has_any (emailsubject_has_any)
  | where array_length(emaildirection_in) == 0 or EmailDirection in~ (emaildirection_in)
  | where array_length(emaildeliverylocation_in) == 0 or (tolower(tostring(['filter'].disposition)) == "quarantine" and "Quarantine" in~ (emaildeliverylocation_in))
  | project-rename EventStartTime = eventTime, EventOriginalUid = guid
  | extend
      EventEndTime = EventStartTime,
      EventUid = EventOriginalUid,
      EventCount = int(1),
      Type = 'ProofpointPODMessage_CL',
      EventVendor = 'Proofpoint',
      EventProduct = 'Proofpoint On Demand Email Security',
      EventProductVersion = tostring(pps.version),
      EventSchema = 'EmailEvent',
      EventSchemaVersion = '1.0.0',
      EventType = 'EmailInspection',
      EventResult = 'NA',
      EventSeverity = 'Informational',
      DvcOriginalAction = tostring(['filter'].disposition),
      DvcScopeId = tostring(pps.cid),
      SrcGeoCountry = tostring(connection.country),
      EmailMailFromAddress = tostring(envelope.from),
      EmailReplyToAddress = mailbox(msg.normalizedHeader.['reply-to']),
      EmailLanguage = tostring(msg.lang),
      _size = coalesce(tolong(msg.sizeBytes), tolong(['filter'].msgSizeBytes)),
      _protocol = toupper(tostring(split(tostring(connection.protocol), ":")[0])),
      EmailSpfOriginalResult = tostring(['filter'].modules.spf.result),
      EmailDkimOriginalResult = iff(array_length(['filter'].modules.dkimv) == 1, tostring(['filter'].modules.dkimv[0].result), ""),
      EmailDmarcOriginalResult = tostring(['filter'].modules.dmarc.filterdResult)
  | extend
      Dvc = coalesce(tostring(pps.agent), tostring(metadata.origin.data.agent), EventProduct),
      DvcAction = case(tolower(DvcOriginalAction) == "reject", "Blocked", tolower(DvcOriginalAction) == "quarantine", "Quarantined", tolower(DvcOriginalAction) == "discard", "Deleted", "NA"),
      EmailSizeBytes = iff(_size >= 0, _size, long(null)),
      EmailProtocolName = iff(_protocol in ("SMTP", "IMAP", "POP3"), _protocol, ""),
      EmailSpfResult = tostring(spf_results[tolower(EmailSpfOriginalResult)]),
      EmailDkimResult = tostring(dkim_results[tolower(EmailDkimOriginalResult)]),
      EmailDmarcResult = tostring(dmarc_results[tolower(EmailDmarcOriginalResult)]),
      EmailDkimDomain = iff(array_length(['filter'].modules.dkimv) == 1, tostring(['filter'].modules.dkimv[0].domain), ""),
      EmailFromDomain = iff(EmailFromAddress contains "@", tolower(tostring(split(EmailFromAddress, "@")[-1])), ""),
      EmailMailFromDomain = iff(EmailMailFromAddress contains "@", tolower(tostring(split(EmailMailFromAddress, "@")[-1])), ""),
      EmailReplyToDomain = iff(EmailReplyToAddress contains "@", tolower(tostring(split(EmailReplyToAddress, "@")[-1])), "")
  | extend EventMessage = strcat(
          iff(isnull(EventStartTime), "Missing or invalid source eventTime. ", ""),
          iff(isempty(EventOriginalUid), "Missing source guid. ", ""),
          iff(isnotempty(_source_ip) and isempty(SrcIpAddr), "Invalid source IP address. ", ""),
          iff(isnotnull(msg) and gettype(msg) != "dictionary", "Invalid msg object. ", ""),
          iff(tostring(msg.parsedAddresses.from) !in ("", "[]") and isempty(EmailFromAddress), "Ambiguous or invalid From address left unmapped. ", ""),
          iff(tostring(msg.parsedAddresses.['to']) !in ("", "[]") and array_length(EmailToRecipients) == 0, "Invalid To recipient value left unmapped. ", ""),
          iff(tostring(msg.parsedAddresses.cc) !in ("", "[]") and array_length(EmailCCRecipients) == 0, "Invalid Cc recipient value left unmapped. ", ""),
          iff(tostring(msg.parsedAddresses.bcc) !in ("", "[]") and array_length(EmailBCCRecipients) == 0, "Invalid Bcc recipient value left unmapped. ", ""),
          iff(_size < 0, "Negative message size left unmapped. ", ""),
          iff(isnotempty(tostring(msg.sizeBytes)) and isnull(tolong(msg.sizeBytes)), "Invalid message size. ", ""),
          iff(isnotempty(EmailSpfOriginalResult) and isempty(EmailSpfResult), "Unrecognized SPF result retained in EmailSpfOriginalResult. ", ""),
          iff(isnotempty(EmailDkimOriginalResult) and isempty(EmailDkimResult), "Unrecognized DKIM result retained in EmailDkimOriginalResult. ", ""),
          iff(isnotempty(EmailDmarcOriginalResult) and isempty(EmailDmarcResult), "Unrecognized DMARC result retained in EmailDmarcOriginalResult. ", ""),
          iff(array_length(['filter'].modules.dkimv) > 1, "Multiple DKIM signatures left unmapped. ", ""))
  | extend
      EventResultDetails = iff(DvcAction in ("Blocked", "Quarantined", "Deleted"), "Other", ""),
      EmailDeliveryLocation = iff(DvcAction == "Quarantined", "Quarantine", ""),
      Src = coalesce(SrcIpAddr, EmailMailFromAddress, EmailFromAddress),
      Dst = coalesce(iff(gettype(envelope.rcpts[0]) == "string", tostring(envelope.rcpts[0]), single_string(envelope.rcpts)), tostring(EmailToRecipients[0])),
      IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
      AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack("connection", connection, "envelope", envelope, "filter", ['filter'], "msg", msg, "msgParts", msgParts, "pps", pps, "metadata", metadata), dynamic({}))
  | project
      Type, TimeGenerated, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventOriginalUid, EventUid,
      EventCount, EventVendor, EventProduct, EventProductVersion, EventSchema,
      EventSchemaVersion, EventType, EventResult, EventResultDetails, EventSeverity,
      EventMessage, Dvc, DvcScopeId, DvcAction, DvcOriginalAction, Src, Dst,
      SrcIpAddr, IpAddr, SrcGeoCountry, EmailFromAddress, EmailFromDomain,
      EmailMailFromAddress, EmailMailFromDomain, EmailReplyToAddress, EmailReplyToDomain,
      EmailToRecipients, EmailCCRecipients, EmailBCCRecipients, EmailSubject,
      EmailSizeBytes, EmailLanguage, EmailProtocolName, EmailDirection,
      EmailDeliveryLocation, EmailSpfResult, EmailSpfOriginalResult,
      EmailDkimResult, EmailDkimOriginalResult, EmailDkimDomain,
      EmailDmarcResult, EmailDmarcOriginalResult, AdditionalFields
};
parser(starttime, endtime, ipaddr_has_any_prefix, emailfromaddress_has_any, emailrecipient_has_any, emailsubject_has_any, emaildirection_in, emaildeliverylocation_in, eventresult, pack)
